description: BPSC TRE 3.0 Computer Science paper containing Part-I Language (English & Hindi), Part-II General Studies, and Part-III Computer Science.

questions.questionText:
Why is Kerala just the place for you if you love variety?
(A) There is something here to please everyone
(B) Kerala has magical backwaters
(C) Kerala is very boring
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: There is something here to please everyone
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: According to the passage, 'Kerala is just the place for you if you love variety. There is something here to please everyone.'

questions.questionText:
Why should you take a trip to the spice gardens in the hills?
(A) To count the spices that are grown there
(B) To buy some spices
(C) To inhale the fragrance of fresh cardamoms
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To count the spices that are grown there
questions.optionC: To inhale the fragrance of fresh cardamoms
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The passage states: 'take a trip to the spice gardens in the hills, to inhale the fragrance of fresh cardamoms'.

questions.questionText:
What is Kerala's cuisine known for?
(A) For its bad taste
(B) For being bland
(C) For its spicy hot flavours
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The text directly mentions that 'Kerala's cuisine is known for its spicy hot flavours.'

questions.questionText:
What gives sea food its pungency?
(A) Coconut and spices
(B) Coconut & spices enhanced by tamarind
(C) Addition of cocacola
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The passage confirms: 'The coconut and the spices give the food - especially the seafood a pungency that is enhanced by tamarind.'

questions.questionText:
Why would foreign bargain-hunter visitors never face a problem in Kerala?
(A) Many foreign languages are spoken in Kerala
(B) Hindi is the language of communication in the cities of kerala.
(C) English is spoken and understood everywhere in Kerala.
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Many foreign languages are spoken in Kerala
questions.optionB: Hindi is the language of communication in the cities of kerala.
questions.optionC: English is spoken and understood everywhere in Kerala.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The passage concludes: 'Bargain-hunters will never have a problem since English is spoken and understood everywhere in Kerala.'

questions.questionText:
If you reach _______ Airport on time, you will catch the flight.
(A) a
(B) an
(C) the
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The context refers to a specific airport where the designated flight departs, requiring the definite article 'the'.

questions.questionText:
You should go for _______ early morning walk.
(A) the
(B) a
(C) an
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The word 'early' starts with a vowel sound, taking the indefinite article 'an'.

questions.questionText:
If 30th April is Tuesday, what day of the week would be 10th May?
(A) Monday
(B) Thursday
(C) Saturday
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: April has 30 days. Adding 10 days to Tuesday: 10 mod 7 = 3 days after Tuesday, which is Friday. Since Friday is not among (A), (B), or (C), option (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
रतन ने दौड़कर अजय को क्यों रोकना चाहा ?
(A) रतन अजय से प्यार करता था
(B) रतन और अजय एक ही स्कूल में पढ़ते थे
(C) एक बार रतन से नाराज होकर अजय भाग रहा था
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionA: रतन अजय से प्यार करता था
questions.optionB: रतन और अजय एक ही स्कूल में पढ़ते थे
questions.optionC: एक बार रतन से नाराज होकर अजय भाग रहा था
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश के अनुसार, 'एक बार रतन से नाराज होकर अजय भाग रहा था। रतन ने दौड़कर अजय को रोकना चाहा।'

questions.questionText:
रतन अजय को अच्छा छात्र बनने के लिए क्यों सलाह देता था ?
(A) दिली दोस्त होने के कारण
(B) एक स्कूल में पढ़ने के कारण
(C) भाई होने के कारण
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionB: एक स्कूल में पढ़ने के कारण
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश में स्पष्ट है: 'रतन और अजय दिली दोस्त थे। इसलिए रतन अजय को अच्छा छात्र बनने के लिए सलाह देता था।'

questions.questionText:
रतन कैसा छात्र था ?
(A) गरीब
(B) पढ़ने में तेज
(C) समझदार
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश में रतन को गरीब तथा पढ़ने में तेज दोनों बताया गया है, अतः 'उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक' सही है।

questions.questionText:
रतन और अजय आपस में क्या थे ?
(A) दोस्त
(B) दिली दोस्त
(C) भाई
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश में स्पष्ट रूप से 'रतन और अजय दिली दोस्त थे' लिखा है।

questions.questionText:
सभी शिक्षक रतन से क्यों प्रसन्न रहते थे ?
(A) रतन की निर्धनता के कारण
(B) रतन के परिश्रमी होने कारण
(C) रतन के व्यवहार के कारण
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश में कहा गया है: 'सभी शिक्षक उसके व्यवहार से प्रसन्न रहते थे।'

questions.questionText:
अजय किस काम में अधिक मन लगाता था ?
(A) झगड़ने में
(B) पढ़ने में
(C) दौड़ने मे
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: अजय 'खेलने-कूदने और बदमाशी में' अधिक मन लगाता था, जो विकल्पों (A), (B), (C) में नहीं है; अतः विकल्प (E) सही है।

questions.questionText:
शिवाजी वीर होने के साथ और क्या थे ?
(A) एक अच्छे राजनीतिज्ञ
(B) श्रेष्ठ विचारक
(C) कुशल सम्राट
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश में उल्लिखित है: 'वे केवल वीर ही नहीं, बल्कि एक अच्छे राजनीतिज्ञ भी थे।'

questions.questionText:
शिवाजी ने लोगों में कौन सी भावना भर दी ?
(A) हिन्दुत्व की
(B) एक राष्ट्र की
(C) वीरता की
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश के अनुसार: 'उन्होंने लोगों में एक राष्ट्र की भावना भर दी और मराठा राज्य की स्थापना की।'

questions.questionText:
शिवाजी कौन थे ?
(A) भारत का पराक्रमी योद्धा
(B) भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक
(C) भारत का महान् सम्राट्
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionB: भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश की पहली पंक्ति है: 'शिवाजी भारत के महान् वीरों में से एक थे।'

questions.questionText:
लोग शिवाजी का आदर क्यों करते थे ?
(A) उनकी वीरता के कारण
(B) कट्टर हिन्दू होने के कारण
(C) उनके अच्छे गुणों के कारण
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश के अनुसार: 'उनके अच्छे गुणों के कारण सभी लोग उनका आदर करते थे।'

questions.questionText:
इनमें 'राजनीतिज्ञ' शब्द का अर्थ है -
(A) वह नीति जिससे राज्य का संचालन होता है
(B) वह नीति जिससे शासन का संचालन होता है
(C) राजनीति से सम्बन्धित नीति
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionA: वह नीति जिससे राज्य का संचालन होता है
questions.optionB: वह नीति जिससे शासन का संचालन होता है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'राजनीतिज्ञ' राजनीति का ज्ञाता या कूटनीतिज्ञ व्यक्ति होता है, नीति नहीं। अतः विकल्प (E) सही है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें अपठित गद्यांश का शीर्षक है।
(A) शिवाजी की राष्ट्रीय चेतना
(B) शिवाजी का जीवन
(C) शिवाजी का पराक्रम
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: गद्यांश शिवाजी के चरित्र और जीवन-दर्शन पर केंद्रित है, अतः 'शिवाजी का जीवन' सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शीर्षक है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा है -
(A) नदी
(B) गंगा
(C) ब्रम्हपुत्र
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'गंगा' और 'ब्रह्मपुत्र' विशिष्ट नदियों के नाम होने के कारण दोनों व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञाएँ हैं।

questions.questionText:
इनमें उत्तमपुरुष सर्वनाम है -
(A) मैं
(B) तू
(C) वह
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: वक्ता अपने लिए 'मैं' का प्रयोग करता है, जो उत्तम पुरुष सर्वनाम है ('तू' मध्यम पुरुष तथा 'वह' अन्य पुरुष है)।

questions.questionText:
'दुकान पर कोई नहीं था।' वाक्य में किस कारक का चिह्न प्रयुक्त हुआ है ?
(A) अपादानकारक
(B) सम्बन्धकारक
(C) अधिकरण कारक
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'दुकान पर' में स्थान-आधार दर्शाने वाला अधिकरण कारक चिह्न 'पर' प्रयुक्त हुआ है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें तत्सम शब्द है -
(A) बच्चा
(B) पुष्प
(C) चौदह
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'पुष्प' संस्कृत का मूल तत्सम शब्द है ('बच्चा' का तत्सम वत्स और 'चौदह' का चतुर्दश है)।

questions.questionText:
इनमें शुद्ध शब्द है -
(A) निरपराधी
(B) प्रमाणिक
(C) महत्व
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: तीनों शब्द अशुद्ध हैं (शुद्ध रूप: निरपराध, प्रामाणिक, महत्त्व)। अतः 'उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं' सही है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें 'उत्कृष्ट' शब्द का विपरीतार्थक शब्द है -
(A) निकृष्ट
(B) अधम
(C) नीच
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'उत्कृष्ट' का सटीक विलोम शब्द 'निकृष्ट' होता है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें शुद्ध वाक्य है -
(A) किसी भी आदमी को भेज दो
(B) हम तो अवश्य जायेंगे
(C) यह कविता अनेक भाव प्रकट करती है
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionA: किसी भी आदमी को भेज दो
questions.optionC: यह कविता अनेक भाव प्रकट करती है
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'यह कविता अनेक भाव प्रकट करती है' व्याकरणिक दृष्टि से पूर्णतः शुद्ध वाक्य है।

questions.questionText:
इनमें 'जल' शब्द का पर्यायवाची शब्द है -
(A) जीवन
(B) अमृत
(C) पानी
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: पानी, जीवन और अमृत तीनों ही 'जल' के पर्यायवाची शब्द हैं।

questions.questionText:
'जहाँ लोगों का मिलन हो' वाक्यखण्ड के लिए एक शब्द है -
(A) मेला
(B) सम्मेलन
(C) मेल
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: जहाँ लोगों का औपचारिक मिलन या विचार-विमर्श हो, उसे 'सम्मेलन' कहा जाता है।

questions.questionText:
'खटाई में पड़ना' मुहावरे का अर्थ है -
(A) झमेले में पड़ना
(B) चैन मिलना
(C) विघ्न आना
(D) उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
(E) उपर्युक्त में से कोई नहीं
questions.optionD: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'खटाई में पड़ना' मुहावरे का अर्थ किसी कार्य का अनिश्चित हो जाना या झमेले/अड़चन में पड़ना होता है।

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is the value of (x+1/x)^2?
(A) x^2 + 1/x^2
(B) x^2 - 1/x^2
(C) x^2 + 1/x^2 + 1
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2. Since this expression is not listed in (A), (B), or (C), 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText:
An article is at 10% more than the CP. If discount of 10% is allowed then which of the following is right?
(A) 1% gain
(B) 1% loss
(C) no gain no loss
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Successive change formula: +10 - 10 - (10*10)/100 = -1%, representing a 1% net loss.

questions.questionText:
By what number should 81 be divided to get a perfect cube?
(A) 3
(B) 6
(C) 7
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 81 / 3 = 27 = 3^3, which is a perfect cube.

questions.questionText:
The difference between two whole numbers is 66. The ratio of the two numbers is 2:5. The two numbers are:
(A) 60 and 6
(B) 100 and 33
(C) 110 and 44
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let numbers be 2x and 5x. 5x - 2x = 3x = 66 => x = 22. Numbers are 44 and 110.

questions.questionText:
In a parallelogram ABCD, angle A and angle B are in the ratio 1:2. Find the angle A.
(A) 30°
(B) 45°
(C) 60°
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram are supplementary: x + 2x = 180° => 3x = 180° => x = 60°.

questions.questionText:
The height of a cylinder whose radius is 7 cm and the total surface area is 968 cm² is:
(A) 15 cm
(B) 17 cm
(C) 19 cm
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
If (-3)^(m+1) * (-3)^5 = (-3)^7, then the value of m is:
(A) 5
(B) 7
(C) 1
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Equating exponents with the same base: (m + 1) + 5 = 7 => m + 6 = 7 => m = 1.

questions.questionText:
If x and y are inversely proportional, then:
(A) y/x = constant
(B) xy = constant
(C) x/y = constant
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In an inverse proportionality relationship, y ∝ 1/x => xy = constant (k).

questions.questionText:
A piece of wire of resistance R is cut into 5 equal parts. These parts are then connected in parallel. If the equivalent resistance of the combination is R' then the ratio R/R' is
(A) 1/25
(B) 1/5
(C) 25
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Each part has resistance R/5. When 5 such resistors are in parallel: 1/R' = 5 * (5/R) = 25/R => R' = R/25. Thus, R/R' = 25.

questions.questionText:
An electric heater of resistance 8 Ω draws 15A current from a service mains for 2 Hrs. What will be the rate at which heat is developed in the heater?
(A) 220 watt
(B) 120 watt
(C) 210 watt
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rate of heat developed is electric power P = I^2 * R = 15^2 * 8 = 225 * 8 = 1800 W. Since 1800 W is not listed, (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following lenses would you prefer to use while reading small letters found in the dictionary?
(A) A convex lens of 50 cm
(B) A concave lens of 50 cm
(C) A concave lens of 5 cm
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A magnifying glass requires a convex lens of short focal length (e.g., 5 cm). Since the convex lens listed has 50 cm focal length, option (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
The human eye forms the image of an object at its
(A) Cornea
(B) Iris
(C) Retina
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Light refracted by the cornea and crystalline lens focuses a real inverted image on the photoreceptive retina.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is not a part of the female reproductive system in human beings ?
(A) Ovary
(B) Uterus
(C) Vas deferens
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The vas deferens is an anatomical component of the male reproductive tract.

questions.questionText:
The anther contains
(A) Sepals
(B) Ovules
(C) Pollen grains
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Anthers are the pollen-bearing sacs of the male stamen in angiosperms.

questions.questionText:
Asexual reproduction takes place through budding in
(A) Amoeba
(B) Yeast
(C) Plasmodium
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Yeast and Hydra reproduce asexually by budding, whereas Amoeba divides by binary fission.

questions.questionText:
Which one of the following types of medicines used for treating indigestion?
(A) Antibiotic
(B) Antacid
(C) Analgesic
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Antacids contain basic alkaline salts that neutralize excess gastric hydrochloric acid to relieve indigestion.

questions.questionText:
The task of processing citizenship applications under the CAA will be undertaken by
(A) Postal Department
(B) Census Department
(C) Central Security IB
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Under the notified Citizenship Amendment Act rules, physical document verification and application processing are assisted via Postal Department officers.

questions.questionText:
In which of the following country India launched its UPI?
(A) Thailand
(B) Myanmar
(C) Mauritius
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: India launched cross-border Unified Payments Interface (UPI) and RuPay connectivity with Mauritius in February 2024.

questions.questionText:
What is the name of space craft to be launched by ISRO in 2024 to carry astronauts?
(A) Akashyan
(B) Gaganyan
(C) Bhramyan
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Gaganyaan is ISRO's human spaceflight mission designed to send Indian astronauts to low Earth orbit.

questions.questionText:
Which country is not a member of G 7?
(A) Russia
(B) Canada
(C) USA
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Russia was suspended from the G8 in 2014 following the annexation of Crimea, returning the group to the G7.

questions.questionText:
The process involved in achieving Green hydrogen is
(A) Electrolysis
(B) Dehydrogenesis
(C) Dehydration
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Green hydrogen is produced by the water electrolysis process powered entirely by renewable electricity.

questions.questionText:
Which technology can be used to revise deceased individuals?
(A) Deepfake
(B) AI
(C) Chatbot
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Deepfake synthesis, generative AI avatars, and conversational chatbots can all be combined to digitally reconstruct personas of deceased persons.

questions.questionText:
In cost of living index parameter 2024 which country is better than India?
(A) Nigeria
(B) Pakistan
(C) Bangladesh
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (B) Pakistan as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText:
Who supported Gandhiji in Champaran Satyagraha in 1917 in support of farmers?
(A) Birsa Munda
(B) Rajendra Prasad
(C) Satya Narayan Sinha
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad, along with J. B. Kripalani, Mahadev Desai, and Narhari Parikh, actively assisted Mahatma Gandhi in Champaran.

questions.questionText:
Which is the moon-like planet?
(A) Mercury
(B) Mars
(C) Earth
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Mercury has a cratered, rocky surface and lacks a significant atmosphere, making it visually similar to Earth's Moon.

questions.questionText:
On the basis of fossils which is the origin place of man?
(A) Rift valley of Africa
(B) Central Asia
(C) Jerusalem
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Paleoanthropological fossil evidence establishes the East African Rift Valley as the cradle of early hominins and Homo sapiens.

questions.questionText:
In India dry point settlement is found in
(A) Flood prone area
(B) Bikaner
(C) Aravali region
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dry-point settlements are established on elevated knolls or natural levees within low-lying flood-prone regions to avoid inundation.

questions.questionText:
In which district of Bihar Paddy crop production is maximum?
(A) Bhojpur
(B) Rohtas
(C) Nalanda
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rohtas district is known as the 'rice bowl of Bihar' due to its extensive canal irrigation and highest paddy production.

questions.questionText:
On which mountain is Tehran situated?
(A) Alburz
(B) Zagros
(C) Makran
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Tehran, the capital of Iran, sits along the southern foothills of the Alborz (Elburz) mountain range.

questions.questionText:
The highest peak in the Eastern Ghats of India is:
(A) Anai Mudi
(B) Kanchenjunga
(C) Mahendragiri
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (C) Mahendragiri as per the official answer key (traditional textbook reference; Jindhagada/Arma Konda is the geographical highest).

questions.questionText:
Which of these statements is not a valid reason for the depletion of flora and fauna?
(A) Agricultural expansion
(B) Large scale development projects
(C) Grazing and fuel wood collection
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Subsistence fuelwood gathering and regulated grazing prune biomass without being the primary driver of total species depletion, unlike broad land-clearing projects.

questions.questionText:
In which district of Bihar silk textile production is maximum?
(A) Madhubani
(B) Bhagalpur
(C) Aurangabad
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bhagalpur is traditionally known as the 'Silk City' of Bihar, renowned for its Tussar and mulberry silk weaving.

questions.questionText:
Who was the viceroy of India during the Jallianwala Bagh massacre?
(A) Lord Curzon
(B) Lord Chelmsford
(C) Lord Irwin
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Lord Chelmsford served as the Viceroy of India from 1916 to 1921 when the Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919.

questions.questionText:
The first President of the Indian National Congress was:
(A) Dadabhai Naoroji
(B) W. C. Bonnerjee
(C) Badruddin Tyabji
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee presided over the inaugural session of the Indian National Congress at Bombay in December 1885.

questions.questionText:
Who among the following is also known as the Grand old man of India?
(A) Bal Gangadhar Tilak
(B) Dadabhai Naoroji
(C) Gopal Krishna Gokhale
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji, author of 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India', is honored as the 'Grand Old Man of India'.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following movements was started by M. K. Gandhi?
(A) Quit India Movement
(B) Non cooperation movement
(C) Swadesi movement
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi launched the Non-Cooperation Movement (1920) and the Quit India Movement (1942).

questions.questionText:
Who was the leader of the Bardoli Satyagraha?
(A) Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
(B) Bal Gangadhar Tilak
(C) Jawaharlal Nehru
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Vallabhbhai Patel successfully led the Bardoli Satyagraha in 1928 against unfair land revenue increases, earning the title 'Sardar'.

questions.questionText:
Who among the following is not associated with Home rule movement?
(A) Annie Besant
(B) Bal Gangadhar Tilak
(C) Sarojini Naidu
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Annie Besant and Bal Gangadhar Tilak established the Home Rule Leagues in 1916; Sarojini Naidu was not a core founder.

questions.questionText:
Who founded the Bihar provincial congress committee in 1920?
(A) Dr. Rajendra Prasad
(B) Anugrah Narayan Sinha
(C) Jai Prakash Narayan
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Bihar Provincial Congress Committee was established in 1908 (presided over by Sir Ali Imam), not in 1920, so 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText:
The All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) was founded in 1936 in Bihar under the leadership of:
(A) Dr. Rajendra Prasad
(B) Jai Prakash Narayan
(C) Swami Sahajanand Saraswati
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati presided over the founding session of the All India Kisan Sabha in Lucknow in April 1936.

questions.questionText:
Digital circuit can be made by the repeated use of the
(A) NAND gate
(B) NOR gate
(C) AND gate
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both NAND and NOR are universal gates that can implement any arbitrary Boolean function independently.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?
(A) They use analog signals for communication
(B) They process information using continuous voltage levels
(C) They are not suitable for high speed operations
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: They use analog signals for communication
questions.optionB: They process information using continuous voltage levels
questions.optionC: They are not suitable for high speed operations
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Digital circuits process discrete binary voltage levels (0 and 1) at high operational speeds; hence all options (A), (B), and (C) are incorrect.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is an example of a digital Electronic?
(A) Computers
(B) Mobile phones
(C) Digital cameras
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Computers, modern smartphones, and digital cameras all operate on digital microprocessors and storage.

questions.questionText:
An OR gate has 4 inputs. The number of words in truth table will be
(A) 4
(B) 8
(C) 16
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: For n binary inputs, a truth table contains 2^n input rows. For n = 4, 2^4 = 16 rows/words.

questions.questionText:
When does a negative level triggered flip-flop in Digital Electronics changes its state?
(A) When the clock is Negative
(B) When the clock is Positive
(C) When the inputs are all zero
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionC: When the inputs are all zero
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Level-triggered latches and flip-flops respond while the clock signal is held at the active low/negative level.

questions.questionText:
What is the result of the operation 1010 AND 1100 in binary?
(A) 1000
(B) 1110
(C) 100
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bitwise AND: 1 AND 1 = 1, 0 AND 1 = 0, 1 AND 0 = 0, 0 AND 0 = 0 => 1000.

questions.questionText:
In a half-adder circuit, what are the outputs?
(A) Sum and Carry
(B) Difference and Borrow
(C) Sum and Difference
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A half adder takes two single-bit inputs and produces Sum (XOR) and Carry (AND) outputs.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is the type of Read Only Memory (ROM)?
(A) PROM
(B) EPROM
(C) MROM
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Mask ROM (MROM), Programmable ROM (PROM), and Erasable Programmable ROM (EPROM) are all types of ROM.

questions.questionText:
What is a PLA?
(A) Programmable Logic Application
(B) Programmable Logic Array
(C) Programmable Logic Architecture
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: PLA stands for Programmable Logic Array, consisting of programmable AND and OR planes.

questions.questionText:
How many select lines are required for an 8-to-1 multiplexer?
(A) 2
(B) 3
(C) 4
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: An n-input multiplexer requires m select lines where 2^m = n. For n = 8, 2^3 = 8, requiring 3 select lines.

questions.questionText:
Convert the decimal number 1234 to binary, octal, and hexadecimal. Which of the following options correctly represents these conversions?
(A) Binary: 10011010010, Octal: 2322, Hexadecimal: 4D2
(B) Binary: 11001110010, Octal: 1712, Hexadecimal: 72A
(C) Binary: 11100110010, Octal: 1642, Hexadecimal: 3CD
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
What is Booth's algorithm used for?
(A) Binary to decimal conversion
(B) Decimal to binary conversion
(C) Binary multiplication
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Booth's multiplication algorithm multiplies signed binary numbers in two's complement notation.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is error detection code used in digital logic?
(A) Hamming code
(B) Cyclic redundancy check (CRC)
(C) Checksum
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Hamming codes, CRCs, and checksums are all standardized error-detection methods in digital communications.

questions.questionText:
When performing BCD addition, what is the maximum value that can be represented in a single BCD digit?
(A) 2
(B) 10
(C) 15
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Binary Coded Decimal (BCD) encodes digits from 0 to 9; the maximum valid value is 9. Since 9 is not listed, (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
Convert the binary number 1011.1101 to its decimal equivalent. Which of the following is the correct decimal value?
(A) 11.75
(B) 12.125
(C) 13.5
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Integer part: 1011 = 11. Fractional part: 1/2 + 1/4 + 0/8 + 1/16 = 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.0625 = 0.8125. Decimal = 11.8125. Since 11.8125 is not listed, (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
What is De Morgan's theorem used for in digital logic?
(A) Simplifying Boolean expressions
(B) Implementing NAND gates
(C) Performing binary addition
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: De Morgan's theorems relate logical AND and OR operators through negation to minimize Boolean expressions.

questions.questionText:
What is the purpose of the "don't care" condition in digital logic?
(A) To indicate that the value of a variable does not affect the output
(B) To prioritize certain inputs over others
(C) To ensure that all possible input combinations are covered in truth tables
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To indicate that the value of a variable does not affect the output
questions.optionB: To prioritize certain inputs over others
questions.optionC: To ensure that all possible input combinations are covered in truth tables
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Don't-care conditions (X) represent input combinations that never occur or whose outputs do not matter, allowing larger grouping in K-maps.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following data structures stores elements in a non-linear relationship?
(A) Stack
(B) Queue
(C) Array
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Stack, Queue, and Array are all linear data structures. Trees and Graphs are non-linear; hence 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText:
Which data structure is used for efficient searching, insertion, and deletion of elements?
(A) Stack
(B) Queue
(C) Hash Table
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Hash tables provide average O(1) constant time complexity for lookup, insertion, and deletion.

questions.questionText:
In a binary search tree, which subtree of a node contains elements that are greater than the node's value?
(A) Left subtree
(B) Right subtree
(C) Both subtrees
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By definition of a BST, all keys in the right subtree are strictly greater than the node's key.

questions.questionText:
The result evaluating the postfix expression 10 5 + 60 6 / * 8 -
(A) 142
(B) 213
(C) 284
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
In a balanced binary tree, the height of two sub-trees of every node can not differ by more than
(A) 2
(B) 1
(C) 0
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In height-balanced trees like AVL trees, the balance factor of any node must be within {-1, 0, +1}.

questions.questionText:
Write the output of the following program:
int a[] = {1, 2, 3}, *p;
(A) Junk value
(B) 3
(C) Runtime error
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The snippet is an incomplete variable declaration without executable print statements or a main function; official key marks (E).

questions.questionText:
A queue has configuration a, b, c, d. If you want to get the configuration d, c, b, a, you need a minimum of
(A) 2 deletions and 3 additions
(B) 3 deletions and 3 additions
(C) 4 deletions and 4 additions
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A queue alone cannot invert element order without an auxiliary stack; option (E) is designated in the key.

questions.questionText:
The order of the binary search algorithm is
(A) N
(B) N log n
(C) N^2
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The time complexity of binary search is O(log N). Because O(log N) is not listed, (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
The preorder traversal of a binary search tree is 15, 10, 12, 11, 20, 18, 16, 19. Which one of the following is the postorder traversal of the tree?
(A) 20, 19, 18, 16, 15, 12, 11, 10
(B) 11, 12, 10, 16, 19, 18, 20, 15
(C) 19, 16, 18, 20, 11, 12, 10, 15
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Reconstructed BST: Left child of 15 is 10, right child of 10 is 12, left of 12 is 11. Right child of 15 is 20, left of 20 is 18 (with children 16 and 19). Postorder traversal yields 11, 12, 10, 16, 19, 18, 20, 15.

questions.questionText:
How many distinct binary search trees can be created out of 4 distinct keys?
(A) 8
(B) 24
(C) 14
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The number of unique BSTs is given by the 4th Catalan number: C_4 = (1/5) * (8 choose 4) = 70 / 5 = 14.

questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The operand inside sizeof is not evaluated at runtime in C. sizeof(int) evaluates to 4, and k remains unchanged at 15.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following statements is true about Big-O notation?
(A) It represents the lower bound of an algorithm's runtime.
(B) It represents the upper bound of an algorithm's runtime
(C) It represents the average runtime of an algorithm.
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: It represents the lower bound of an algorithm's runtime.
questions.optionB: It represents the upper bound of an algorithm's runtime
questions.optionC: It represents the average runtime of an algorithm.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Big-O notation formalizes the asymptotic upper bound on the growth rate of an algorithm's running time.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a step in the Divide and Conquer algorithm?
(A) Combine
(B) Conquer
(C) Divide
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The three classical algorithmic steps are Divide, Conquer, and Combine. Since all three are steps, 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText:
Merge Sort is an example of which algorithm design paradigm?
(A) Greedy
(B) Divide and Conquer
(C) Dynamic Programming
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Merge sort divides the unsorted list into halves, sorts them recursively, and merges the sorted sublists.

questions.questionText:
How many edges does a spanning tree of a graph with N vertices have?
(A) N
(B) N - 1
(C) N(N-1)/2
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A spanning tree on N connected vertices contains exactly N - 1 edges without cycles.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a graph traversal algorithm?
(A) Greedy
(B) Divide and Conquer
(C) Dynamic Programming
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Greedy, Divide & Conquer, and Dynamic Programming are general algorithm paradigms, not graph traversal algorithms (like BFS and DFS).

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT an NP-Complete problem?
(A) Traveling Salesman Problem
(B) Boolean Satisfiability Problem
(C) Shortest Path Problem
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Single-source shortest path problems can be solved in polynomial time using Dijkstra's or Bellman-Ford algorithm.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is an advantage of using arrays?
(A) Constant time insertion and deletion
(B) Ability to store elements of different data types
(C) Random access to elements using an index
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: Ability to store elements of different data types
questions.optionC: Random access to elements using an index
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Arrays provide O(1) random access to any element via its integer index.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a basic operation performed on a data structure?
(A) Encryption
(B) Deletion
(C) Insertion
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Standard data structure primitive operations are traversal, insertion, deletion, searching, and sorting; encryption is a cryptographic operation.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a type of operating system?
(A) Real-time operating system
(B) Embedded operating system
(C) Network operating system
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: RTOS, embedded OS, and network OS are all recognized classifications of operating systems.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a memory management technique used by operating systems?
(A) Paging
(B) Segmentation
(C) Fragmentation
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fragmentation is an undesirable phenomenon (internal or external), not an allocation technique.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a file system commonly used in operating systems?
(A) NTFS
(B) FAT32
(C) HFS+
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: NTFS and FAT32 are used in Windows, while HFS+ was developed for macOS.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a type of interrupt?
(A) Hardware interrupt
(B) Memory interrupt
(C) Software interrupt
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Interrupts are categorized into hardware (external asynchronous) and software (internal synchronous traps/exceptions); 'memory interrupt' is not a standard category.

questions.questionText:
What is a page in paging?
(A) A fixed-size block of virtual memory
(B) A fixed-size block of physical memory
(C) A type of memory allocation
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: A fixed-size block of virtual memory
questions.optionB: A fixed-size block of physical memory
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A page is a contiguous, fixed-length block of virtual memory, whereas a frame is a block of physical memory.

questions.questionText:
In a system with a page size of 4 KB and a physical address space of 64 GB, what is the number of bits required for the page offset?
(A) 10 bits
(B) 12 bits
(C) 14 bits
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Page offset bits = log2(Page Size) = log2(4 * 1024 bytes) = log2(2^12) = 12 bits.

questions.questionText:
What is a segment base in segmentation?
(A) The starting address of a segment in physical memory
(B) The starting address of a segment in virtual memory
(C) The ending address of a segment in physical memory
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: The starting address of a segment in physical memory
questions.optionB: The starting address of a segment in virtual memory
questions.optionC: The ending address of a segment in physical memory
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The segment base register in a segment table contains the starting physical address where the segment resides.

questions.questionText:
What causes thrashing to occur?
(A) Excessive paging activity
(B) Insufficient disk space
(C) Hardware failures
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when an operating system spends more time servicing page faults and swapping pages than executing instructions.

questions.questionText:
Consider a system with a total physical memory of 8 GB and total virtual memory of 16 GB. If the system is using 6 GB of physical memory and 10 GB of virtual memory, how much memory is being swapped out?
(A) 2 GB
(B) 4 GB
(C) 6 GB
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (A) 2 GB as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText:
How is the TLB typically organized?
(A) As a direct-mapped cache
(B) As an associative cache
(C) As a set-associative cache
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Translation Lookaside Buffers (TLBs) can be engineered as fully associative or set-associative hardware caches.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a common file operation?
(A) Create
(B) Delete
(C) Rename
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operating systems provide standard file management system calls including create, open, read, write, rename, and delete.

questions.questionText:
Consider a disk queue with requests for I/O to blocks on cylinders. 98 183 37 122 14 124 65 67 considering FCFS (First Come First Served) scheduling, the total number of head movements is, if the disk head is initially at 53 is?
(A) 640
(B) 620
(C) 630
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above

questions.questionText:
Thread shares with other threads belonging to the same process its
(A) thread ID
(B) program counter
(C) code section and data section
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Threads belonging to the same process share code, data sections, and OS resources, while keeping private thread IDs, registers, and stacks.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a type of DBMS?
(A) Relational DBMS
(B) Object-Oriented DBMS
(C) Sequential DBMS
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Relational, network, hierarchical, and object-oriented are recognized DBMS types; 'Sequential DBMS' is not an established category.

questions.questionText:
In a relational database, what is a primary key?
(A) A key used to uniquely identify each record in a table
(B) A key used to establish relationships between tables
(C) A key used to sort records in a table
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: A key used to uniquely identify each record in a table
questions.optionB: A key used to establish relationships between tables
questions.optionC: A key used to sort records in a table
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A primary key is a column or set of columns that uniquely identifies every tuple in a table without containing NULLs.

questions.questionText:
Which normal form ensures that every non-prime attribute in a table is fully functionally dependent on the primary key?
(A) First Normal Form (1NF)
(B) Second Normal Form (2NF)
(C) Third Normal Form (3NF)
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Second Normal Form (2NF) requires a relation to be in 1NF and have no partial functional dependencies on any candidate key.

questions.questionText:
Which SQL command is used to add new rows to a database table?
(A) ADD
(B) CREATE
(C) INSERT
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 'INSERT INTO' SQL statement inserts new records/tuples into a relational table.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a disadvantage of using a distributed database system?
(A) Improved data accessibility
(B) Increased data security
(C) Data inconsistency
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Maintaining concurrency control and replica consistency across geographically distributed nodes introduces risks of data inconsistency.

questions.questionText:
What is the primary function of a router in a computer network?
(A) To connect devices within the same network
(B) To connect multiple networks together
(C) To filter incoming traffic based on IP addresses
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To connect devices within the same network
questions.optionC: To filter incoming traffic based on IP addresses
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Routers operate at the Network Layer (Layer 3) to route packets across disparate interconnected networks.

questions.questionText:
In the OSI model, which layer is responsible for routing and forwarding data packets?
(A) Data Link Layer
(B) Transport Layer
(C) Physical Layer
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Network Layer (Layer 3) handles routing and packet forwarding. Because the Network Layer is not listed in (A), (B), or (C), option (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
Which device is used to connect multiple devices within the same local area network (LAN)?
(A) Router
(B) Switch
(C) Bridge
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A network switch connects multiple end-user devices within a common LAN and forwards frames based on MAC addresses.

questions.questionText:
Which protocol is used to send email over the Internet?
(A) FTP
(B) SMTP
(C) HTTP
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) handles outgoing electronic mail delivery.

questions.questionText:
What is the purpose of a subnet mask in TCP/IP networking?
(A) To identify the network portion of an IP address
(B) To identify the host portion of an IP address
(C) To convert IP addresses into domain names
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To identify the network portion of an IP address
questions.optionB: To identify the host portion of an IP address
questions.optionC: To convert IP addresses into domain names
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A subnet mask performs a bitwise AND with an IP address to isolate the network prefix from the host identifier.

questions.questionText:
What is the maximum data rate of Bluetooth version 5.0?
(A) 1 Mbps
(B) 2 Mbps
(C) 5 Mbps
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bluetooth 5.0 introduced a 2 Mbps high-speed physical layer (2M PHY) mode.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a software development life cycle model?
(A) Waterfall model
(B) Agile model
(C) Spiral model
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Waterfall, Agile, and Spiral are all established software development life cycle (SDLC) models.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a software development requirement?
(A) Functional requirements
(B) System requirements
(C) Physical requirements
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Software requirements specifications capture functional, non-functional, and system constraints; 'physical requirements' typically describe hardware manufacturing.

questions.questionText:
What is the main difference between verification and validation in software testing?
(A) Verification ensures that the software is bug-free, while validation ensures that it meets the requirements.
(B) Verification is done before coding, while validation is done after coding.
(C) Verification checks if the software is built right, while validation checks if the right software is built.
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Verification ensures that the software is bug-free, while validation ensures that it meets the requirements.
questions.optionB: Verification is done before coding, while validation is done after coding.
questions.optionC: Verification checks if the software is built right, while validation checks if the right software is built.
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Barry Boehm defined verification as 'Are we building the product right?' and validation as 'Are we building the right product?'.

questions.questionText:
What is the purpose of a software prototype?
(A) To serve as the final version of the software
(B) To replace detailed documentation
(C) To speed up the software development process
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To serve as the final version of the software
questions.optionC: To speed up the software development process
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A prototype's main purpose is to clarify ambiguous user requirements and evaluate technical feasibility; official key marks (E).

questions.questionText:
What is the primary goal of software engineering?
(A) To write code efficiently
(B) To develop software that meets user requirements within budget and schedule constraints
(C) To develop software with the latest technologies
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionB: To develop software that meets user requirements within budget and schedule constraints
questions.optionC: To develop software with the latest technologies
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Software engineering applies systematic engineering disciplines to build reliable software that meets client needs within cost and time budgets.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a pillar of OOP?
(A) Inheritance
(B) Encapsulation
(C) Abstraction
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The four pillars of object-oriented programming are Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, and Polymorphism.

questions.questionText:
Which keyword is used in Java to implement inheritance?
(A) extends
(B) inherits
(C) implements
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Java, a subclass uses the 'extends' keyword to inherit from a superclass.

questions.questionText:
What is the access specifier used to make members of a class accessible only within the same package?
(A) private
(B) public
(C) package-private
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Package-private (default access without any explicit modifier in Java) restricts accessibility to classes within the same package.

questions.questionText:
Inheritance in OOP allows a class to:
(A) Inherit properties and behavior from another class
(B) Create instances of another class
(C) Override methods of another class
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: Inherit properties and behavior from another class
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Inheritance allows a subclass to acquire fields and methods from a base class, establishing an 'is-a' hierarchy.

questions.questionText:
What is the purpose of HTML in a web application?
(A) To define the structure of web pages
(B) To style web pages
(C) To add interactivity to web pages
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionA: To define the structure of web pages
questions.optionC:
To add interactivity to web pages
(D) More than one of the above
questions.explanation: HTML provides the semantic skeleton and document structure for web content.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is an example of a server-side scripting language commonly used in web applications?
(A) HTML
(B) CSS
(C) C++
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Common server-side scripting languages include PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node.js. Since none are listed in (A), (B), or (C), option (E) is correct.

questions.questionText:
What is the computational complexity of the halting problem?
(A) O(1)
(B) O(n)
(C) Not computable
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Alan Turing proved in 1936 that the Halting Problem is undecidable (not computable) by any general algorithm.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a component of a Turing machine?
(A) Input tape
(B) Output tape
(C) Control unit
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A standard Turing machine uses a single infinite tape that serves for both reading and writing, rather than a separate output tape.

questions.questionText:
Which wireless communication technology is commonly used in IoT devices for short-range communication?
(A) Bluetooth
(B) Wi-Fi
(C) 4G LTE
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Designated option (A) Bluetooth as per the official answer key for short-range personal area networks.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is an example of an IoT protocol used for device communication?
(A) HTTP
(B) FTP
(C) MQTT
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) is a lightweight publish-subscribe network protocol designed for constrained IoT devices.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a subfield of AI?
(A) Machine Learning
(B) Robotics
(C) Natural Language Processing
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Machine Learning, Robotics, Computer Vision, and NLP are all subfields of Artificial Intelligence.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a supervised learning algorithm?
(A) Decision Tree
(B) K-means Clustering
(C) Reinforcement Learning
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Decision Trees learn from labeled training data in supervised learning, whereas K-means is unsupervised.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is NOT a common type of E-Commerce model?
(A) Business-to-Consumer (B2C)
(B) Consumer-to-Business (C2B)
(C) Consumer-to-Consumer (C2C)
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: B2C, C2B, and C2C are all recognized commercial e-commerce business models, so 'None of the above' is correct.

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is an example of a B2C E-Commerce website?
(A) Alibaba
(B) Amazon
(C) Google
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Amazon functions primarily as an online retail storefront selling directly to consumers (B2C).

questions.questionText:
Which of the following is a multimedia authoring tool?
(A) Microsoft Word
(B) Adobe Photoshop
(C) Adobe Flash
(D) More than one of the above
(E) None of the above
questions.optionD: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Adobe Flash (now Adobe Animate) is an authoring tool used to create interactive vector animations and multimedia applications.
